verdict.rationale: Sumsub docs confirm configurable AML/watchlist screening (sumsub-docs-6) and a webhook system that fires on 'events and changes' in an applicant's verification process (sumsub-docs-3/16), which together imply some ongoing screening and event notification. However, no evidence explicitly describes continuous re-screening of already-approved applicants against updated watchlists or a dedicated 'ongoing monitoring' event type distinct from initial verification. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of periodic/automatic re-screening cadence, watchlist-update-triggered events, and confirmation these events fire for already-verified (not just in-progress) applicants.
